Heretical Splinter · Growing

A minority who've heard the same arithmetic every Unanswered eventually half-suspects — that Earth stopped being worth defending, not just worth loving — and drawn the practical conclusion: rebuild the position, not just the virtue. The Reclamation works to consolidate settlements, arm them, and make the world a holding worth contesting again, on the theory that a God that left for leverage reasons returns for leverage reasons. The Patient consider this a category error dressed up as piety. The Reclamation consider the Patient's stillness a two-century excuse for doing nothing.
